title: Report a problem
intro: Tell us what happened so support can help resolve it.
deadline: Report before {date} at {time}; after that, the booking is approved automatically.
reasonHint: Choose the reason that describes what happened.
descriptionHint: Use 20 to 2,000 characters. Include what needs to be put right.
photosHint: Add up to 6 photos, up to {megabytes} MB each. Avoid house numbers, mail, and faces.
supportNote: Support will look at what happened. The payment stays on hold until it's resolved.
confirmDescription: Support and your helper will receive your report. The payment stays on hold until the problem is resolved.
success: Your problem was reported. Support will review what happened.

errors.expired: The approval window ended. Contact support for help with this booking.
errors.not_allowed: This booking has changed. Reload the booking details before continuing.

unavailable.title: This report can't be sent now
unavailable.not_submitted: Your helper hasn't submitted the work yet. Return to the booking to see the latest update.
unavailable.window_passed: The approval window ended and the booking was approved. Contact support if you still need help.
unavailable.closed: This booking is already completed, canceled, or has a problem reported. Return to the booking to see what happens next.
